In this unit we are exploring measurements of two- and three-dimensional shapes and how these measurements are used to solve real world problems. At the end of this investigation, ask yourself:

What do you know about measurements of two- and three-dimensional shapes?

At this point students can talk add to these ideas to their Investigation 1 and 2 thoughts:

talk about area and circumference of a circle, calculate the area and circumference of a circle, and connect that understanding to the volume of a cylinder.

Area of a circle is π • r2

Circumference of a circle is d • π
